acquisition_method.evidence: Data were acquired in DDA mode, using a 2-sec cycle method.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: The residual acetone was removed by brief evaporation and the precipitate was resuspended (600 μl) in urea buffer containing 100 mM N-ethylmaleimide (d0-NEM) (E3876, Sigma), dissolved in ethanol, to label the reduced cysteines.
Samples were further alkylated by adding 5 mM (final concentration) d5-NEM (DLM-6711, CIL) and incubated (50 °C, 30 min, 1200 rpm shaking).

Following precipitation with 20 % TCA, the samples were resuspended (250 μl) in urea buffer, reduced with 5.5 mM TCEP and further alkylated by adding 100 mM d5-NEM (dissolved in ethanol) (final concentration).

cleavage_agent.evidence: In brief, after loading, samples were washed with 90:10 % methanol/50 mM ammonium bicarbonate and then digested (1.5 h, 47 °C) with trypsin (1:50 trypsin/protein).

fractionation_method.evidence: Each sample was fractionated offline using high-pH reversed-phase separation, followed by online low-pH reversed-phase separation.

fragmentation_method.evidence: MS2 was performed in the Orbitrap after HCD fragmentation, with resolution set to 15,000 and maximum injection time set to 60 msec.

instrument.evidence: The nanoUPLC was coupled online through a nanoESI emitter (10 μm tip; New Objective; Woburn, MA, USA) to a quadrupole orbitrap mass spectrometer (Orbitrap Fusion Lumos, Thermo Scientific) using a FlexIon nanospray apparatus (Proxeon).
